description: This file defines the LoggerAppenderDb class which is a part of the log4php logging framework. It implements a log appender that writes log events to a database table using PEAR::DB. The class includes methods for setting up the database connection, creating the log table if needed, formatting log events into SQL queries, appending logs, and managing configuration options.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderDb
classes.description: A log4php appender that writes log events to a database table using PEAR::DB. It supports creating the log table automatically and formatting log events into SQL INSERT statements for database logging.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderDb
methods.description: Constructor for the LoggerAppenderDb class, initializing the object with a given appender name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using the provided DSN, and creates the log table if it does not exist and creation is enabled.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Formats a log event into an SQL query and executes it to log the event into the database table.

methods.name: getCreateTable
methods.description: Returns whether the appender is configured to create the log table if it does not exist.

methods.name: getDsn
methods.description: Returns the current Data Source Name (DSN) used for database connection.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Returns the SQL pattern string used to format log events.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the database table used for logging.

methods.name: setCreateTable
methods.description: Sets whether the appender should create the log table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setDsn
methods.description: Sets the DSN string for database connection.

methods.name: setSql
methods.description: Sets the SQL pattern string for formatting log events.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Sets the name of the database table for logging.
